reports.title: CELESTICA ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS

guidance.heading: 2026 Annual Outlook Update
section: •Free cash flow (non-GAAP)* of $460 million (previous outlook $600 million) (2)
Our previous adjusted operating margin (non-GAAP)* outlook of 8.4% remains unchanged.
(1) The change of our 2026 annual outlook for revenue and adjusted EPS (non-GAAP)* is driven by our strong results in Q3 2026, as well as expected demand improvements for Q4 2026.
(2) The change of our 2026 annual outlook for free cash flow (non-GAAP)* is primarily driven by targeted working capital investments to support the accelerating growth in 2027.
2027 Annual Outlook and Long-Term Demand Update
•Capital expenditures of between $1.5 billion and $2.0 billion
(1) 2027 guidance assumes an adjusted effective tax rate (non-GAAP)* of approximately 21%.
